title: Olive Green Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top for Women with White Floral Yoke
color_custom: Olive green with white floral embroidery
description:
Earthy, elegant and timeless. This olive-green cotton tunic is framed with crisp white floral embroidery – a full yoke of vines and blossoms, with matching embroidered borders at the cuffs and hem.

✦ The Details
• Notched round neckline with embroidered border
• White floral thread embroidery on the yoke
• Embroidered borders on 3/4 sleeves, hem and side slits
• Hip length
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft and breathable. The white embroidery pops against the deep olive for a clean, classic contrast.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed, boxy look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans and nude heels; white trousers for office; a white palazzo and silver jhumkas for a festive day; cat-eye sunglasses for an easy city look.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
